title: The 1965 Nobel citation: genetic control of enzyme and virus synthesis
summary: The Nobel Foundation credits François Jacob, André Lwoff, and Jacques Monod with discoveries concerning genetic control of enzyme and virus synthesis.
body: The Nobel Prize API record for 1965 in physiology or medicine says François Jacob, André Lwoff, and Jacques Monod were awarded the prize for their discoveries concerning genetic control of enzyme and virus synthesis. The record dates the award 14 October 1965. The motivation is that phrase. It does not, in the sentence that was read, name the operon or a repressor.

sources.title: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 1965
sources.author: Nobel Foundation
sources.note: Motivation text was read from the Nobel Prize API record.
